overview: 今日共收录4篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Borosulfates Hosting Se42+ Ions—Crystal Structures, Chemical Bonding, Optical Spectroscopy, and Magnetism
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Borosulfates Hosting Se42+ Ions—Crystal Structures, Chemical Bonding, Optical Spectroscopy, and Magnetism
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Borosulfates Hosting Se42+ Ions—Crystal Structures, Chemical Bonding, Optical Spectroscopy, and Magnetism》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: An Integrated Geospatial Framework for Spatio-Temporal Monitoring of Surface Albedo, Thermal and Vegetation Dynamics in Amrapali Coal-Mine Overburden, Eastern India
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An Integrated Geospatial Framework for Spatio-Temporal Monitoring of Surface Albedo, Thermal and Vegetation Dynamics in Amrapali Coal-Mine Overburden, Eastern India
full_list.abstract: Monitoring coal-mine rehabilitation primarily relies on single vegetation indices, which reflect greenness but overlook surface transitions that precede vegetation growth, and are rarely integrated into a reproducible spatio-temporal workflow. Surface albedo is a promising yet underutilized metric for early-stage reclamation, but integrated multi-indicator assessments remain sparse. This study addresses this gap for the Amrapali opencast coal-mine overburden in Chatra, Jharkhand, establishing a pre-restoration baseline (2013–2026). Annual composites of surface albedo, land surface temperature (LST) and NDVI were derived from Landsat imagery across a 10 km buffer, and land use/land cover (LULC) change was quantified (2015–2025). Trends were assessed with OLS regression, the Mann–Kendall test and Sen's slope, and relationships with Pearson and Spearman correlations. Surface albedo showed a significant declining trend (Mann–Kendall p = 0.004; Sen's slope = − 0.00137 yr⁻¹; R² = 0.60), the clearest signal of landscape change, consistent with progressive darkening of the stabilizing overburden. NDVI showed no significant trend but high variability (CV = 13.4%), and LST remained stable despite an approximately 3.7-fold mine expansion. A significant inverse NDVI–LST relationship (Spearman ρ = −0.55, p = 0.043) confirmed vegetation cooling, whereas weak albedo–LST and NDVI–albedo associations indicate that surface material changes, not canopy greenness, governed the albedo decline. LULC analysis documented contraction of open land ( ~ − 39%) and vegetation ( ~ − 16%) alongside mine, built-up and agricultural expansion. By fusing albedo, LST, NDVI and LULC in a spatially-explicit, multi-temporal framework built on openly available data, this study identifies albedo as a sensitive early-stage indicator and contributes a transparent, transferable geospatial workflow and baseline for evaluating future restoration.

full_list.implication: 对《An Integrated Geospatial Framework for Spatio-Temporal Monitoring of Surface Albedo, Thermal and Vegetation Dynamics in Amrapali Coal-Mine Overburden, Eastern India》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Isolation and Characterization of a Clinically-Derived Staphylococcus epidermidis HE23: Revealing Its Antibiotic Resistome and Metabolic Potential
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Isolation and Characterization of a Clinically-Derived Staphylococcus epidermidis HE23: Revealing Its Antibiotic Resistome and Metabolic Potential
full_list.abstract: Neonatal incubators may serve as environmental reservoirs for antimicrobial-resistant bacteria in neonatal intensive care units. In this study, Staphylococcus epidermidis HE23 was isolated from a high-touch surface of a neonatal incubator and characterized using whole-genome sequencing, comparative genomics, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and metabolomic analysis. Hybrid assembly of Illumina and Nanopore sequencing reads generated a complete genome consisting of a circular chromosome (2,542,743 bp) and two plasmids (50,114 bp and 9,031 bp). Genomic analysis identified nine antibiotic resistance genes, including the chromosomal β-lactam resistance determinants blaZ and mecA and the plasmid-borne mupirocin resistance gene mupA. Antimicrobial susceptibility testing further confirmed resistance to multiple antibiotics, including β-lactams and quinolones. Genes associated with resistance to cationic antimicrobial peptides were also identified, suggesting potential mechanisms that may facilitate persistence under antimicrobial pressure. Metabolomic profiling detected several secondary metabolites, including putatively annotated cinobufagin and harmaline. Comparative genomic analysis further revealed conserved and strain-specific genomic features of HE23. The coexistence of chromosomal resistance determinants and plasmid-associated mupA highlights the potential of incubator-associated S. epidermidis to act as a reservoir of antimicrobial resistance in neonatal intensive care environments. These findings support strengthened microbial surveillance and targeted infection-control strategies for neonatal incubators.

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在机器学习与物理建模，并落到磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、声子、有限温度和输运性质、缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。
